title: Checkout API latency spike
description: Checkout API latency increased above 5 seconds during a traffic spike.
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by insufficient pool size during increased traffic.
resolution: Increased database connection pool size from 50 to 120 connections.

title: Checkout timeouts during flash-sale traffic
description: Checkout requests began timing out during a flash-sale traffic surge. API latency increased rapidly and payment requests started queuing.
